content: No, that is not true. In Switzerland, it is possible to receive the AHV (Old Age and Survivors' Insurance) pension early, but it will be reduced. You can claim the pension between the ages of 63 and 70. If you take it early (for example, at age 63), the amount you receive will be permanently reduced. Conversely, if you defer the pension beyond the standard retirement age of 65, the amount will be increased.
